mBuff.mDescription:
WarpathHecarim gains Attack Damage equal to @f2@% of his bonus Move Speed.

Current Attack Damage Bonus: @f1@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Hecarim gains Attack Damage equal to a percentage of his bonus Move Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Hecarim gains <scaleAD>@BonusAD@ Attack Damage</scaleAD>, increasing based on level.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_HecarimPassive_Tooltip}}

Attack Damage scales with bonus Move speed.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Devastating Charge</titleLeft><mainText>Hecarim is gaining speed and can move through units. His next attack will deal bonus damage based on distance traveled and knock back the target.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Hecarim gains increasing Move Speed and can move through units for a short duration. His next attack knocks the target back and deals additional physical damage based on the distance he has traveled since activating the ability.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Hecarim becomes Ghosted and gains <speed>@MinMoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed</speed> increasing to <speed>@MaxMoveSpeed*100@%</speed> over @Duration@ seconds. His next Attack <status>Knocks Back</status> and deals between <physicalDamage>@MinDamage@</physicalDamage> and <physicalDamage>@MaxDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. <status>Knock Back</status> distance and damage scales with distance travelled during this Ability.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.
The remaining duration of this Ability is paused during {{Spell_HecarimUlt_Name}}.
{{ buff_desc_SpellEffects }}

mLocKeys.keySummary: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies dealing physical damage. If Hecarim damages at least one enemy, he increases the damage and lowers the cooldown of subsequent Rampages.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies for @Damage@ physical damage. If this Ability hits, he gains a stack that decreases its Cooldown by @RampageCooldownReduction@ seconds and increases its damage by @RampageBonusDamagePerc@% for @BuffDuration@ seconds. Stacks up to @MaxStacks@ times.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Deals a base of <physicalDamage>@MinionDamage@ damage</physicalDamage> to minions.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Rampage</titleLeft><mainText>Hecarim's Rampage skill has its damage increased and Cooldown reduced for each stack of this buff.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing magic damage in a line. Hecarim creates a shockwave when he finishes his charge, causing nearby enemies to flee in terror.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing <magicDamage>@DamageDone@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Hecarim unleashes a shockwave at the end of the charge that <status>Fears</status> for between @FearDurationMin@ to @FearDurationMax@ seconds, increased by charge distance.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Hecarim will move to the targeted location, but the riders always move the full distance.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Spirit of Dread</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is taking damage over time. Any damage this unit takes heals Hecarim.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Spirit of Dread</titleLeft><mainText>Hecarim has increased Armor and Magic Resist. Hecarim is damaging nearby enemies and healing when they take damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Hecarim gains Armor and Magic Resist. Hecarim deals magic damage to nearby enemies, and gains Health equal to a percentage of any damage those enemies suffer.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Hecarim deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @BuffDuration@ seconds to nearby enemies.

Hecarim gains @ResistAmount@ Armor and Magic Resist and heals for @LeechAmount@% of damage nearby enemies take from Hecarim and @AllyTooltipLeachValue@% of damage taken from his allies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Hecarim cannot heal more than <healing>@MinionHealCap@ Health</healing> from minions or jungle monsters.</rules>
